rationale: The Old English lemma 'ELN' (ell) is a unit of linear measurement, and "royal" here functions as an adjective modifier (e.g., "royal ell" — a standardized measure), not as a standalone noun. Neither candidate synset (a type of sail or a stag with many antler branches) matches this adjectival/attributive use of "royal" as a qualifier for a unit of measurement.
